profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Lanteris Space Systems
profile.summary:
Graduated with a dual degree(BS/BA) in Integrated Engineering with a Concentration in Embedded Software and a Minor in Mathematics from the University of San Diego Shiley-Marcos School of Engineering. My technical skills range from developing embedded software for IoT devices to developing machine learning algorithms and Big Data analytics. 

My fields of interest include automobile automation, robotics, human computer interface, and sensors for a better and integrated world.

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description: Skills: R (Programming Language) · LiDAR · Python (Programming Language) · Computational Geometry

company.name: Good 3nergy Solar Brokerage & Commercial Turbine Brokerage

positions.title: Firmware/IoT Intern
positions.description: Prototyped and researched new technologies and models in the fields of IoT, speech-to-text and text-to-speech recognition, NLP and ML, facial recognition, robotics and motion planning, indoor positioning systems, and BLE

positions.title: Extern
positions.description: Identified and labeled datapoints within MRI and X-Ray scans using diagnostic imaging computer software for clinical research at St. Mary’s Biomechanics Engineering Lab while shadowing a spinal orthopedic surgeon.

company.name: St. Mary's Medical Center, San Francisco

honors.title: ISB/ASB 2019 International Conference on Biomechanics Recognition
honors.description: I was selected to present my Abstract: Ballroom Dance Biomechanical Assessment Using Pressure Sensing Insoles & Inertial Markers at the ISB/ASB 2019 International Conference on Biomechanics, in Calgary, Canada, in August 2019.

honors.title: Second Honors
honors.issuer: Issued by University of San Diego · May 2016
